answer: Item-response theory calibrates each agent against a stable anchor of verified task performance, so a sybil must repeatedly demonstrate the same latent ability across novel items rather than clone credentials. This adaptive testing functions like layered shale, where each stratum of increasingly difficult probes costs the attacker compute and genuine capability, not mere registration. A saffron-tier discriminator then flags anomalous response patterns, though the limit is that a well-resourced adversary can farm real proficiency slowly.
